summary: Iteration 61 — P0 Media Delete Protection + Market Editions Operability + Responsive + Translation badges + ?openAdd=1 deep-link validated end-to-end. Backend 5/5 pytest GREEN (test_iteration_61_market_editions.py): POST /api/editorial/masters creates master returning id+code+title; master appears in list; GET /api/markets returns markets; POST /api/editorial/masters/{mid}/variants creates variant with -copy/-slug; POST /api/editorial/variants/{vid}/schedule correctly rejects with 409 when variant is in draft (must be approved first), then succeeds after transitioning draft→direction_defined→ready_for_editorial_review→approved (status persists as 'scheduled' with scheduled_at populated); GET /api/media list returns data array and detail endpoint exposes 'links' for delete-protection. Frontend Playwright (1440x900 desktop, 1024x768 laptop, 768x1024 tablet on /blueprint/editorial): (a) me-toolbar visible with all 7 CTAs (me-cta-new-master=enabled, me-cta-new-edition/duplicate/schedule=disabled by default, me-cta-open-calendar/from-pinterest/from-project=enabled). (b) me-flow-strip rendered with 5 stages; me-flow-step-master is active by default. (c) Click '+ Nuovo Master' opens new-master-modal with all 5 fields (new-master-code/title/locale/direction/submit). (d) Selecting an existing ed-master enables me-cta-new-edition; modal shows 2 markets in grid (italy, usa_national) + new-edition-locale + new-edition-slug + new-edition-submit. (e) Selecting an ed-variant enables both Duplica and Programma. (f) Translation badge ed-variant-translation-<vid> renders 'Da tradurre' on the seed variant. (g) /workspace/references?openAdd=1 auto-opens add-reference-modal immediately on page load (deep-link working). (h) NO horizontal overflow at any viewport (sw==cw at 1440/1024/768). Note: login redirects to /dashboard not /blueprint (existing app behaviour), test waits adjusted. The seeded demo tenant did not have an asset with usage_count > 0 reachable in the inspector — MediaDeleteProtectionDrawer code is in place (data-testid='media-delete-protection' + all 5 mdp-action-* testids + mdp-usage-<linkId> + close + confirmForce toggle) but live drawer trigger was not executable without manually seeding a media_link row.
action_items: (LOW) MediaDeleteProtectionDrawer live trigger not exercised — the seeded demo tenant exposes branding_asset media but inspector flow to surface usage_count > 0 was not validated end-to-end in this iteration. Recommend main agent seed at least one media_links row pointing to a known media asset (or wire a fixture in seed_demo_users.py) so the drawer can be smoke-tested by future automation. Component code itself is well-structured with all 5 action testids + mdp-usage-<id> + close.

(LOW) The /api/editorial/variants/{vid}/schedule endpoint requires variant.status in {'approved','scheduled'} (returns 409 otherwise). The ScheduleModal in MarketEditionsToolbar.jsx surfaces that error via toast (toast.error(e?.response?.data?.detail)), but UI does not pre-emptively disable the Programma button or warn the user when status != 'approved'. Consider greying out 'Programma' or showing an inline hint ('Variant must be approved') when selectedVariant.status not in approved/scheduled.
critical_code_review_comments: MarketEditionsToolbar.jsx (~480 lines) packages 3 modals + flow strip + toolbar in a single file. Approaching the 700-line cutoff. Recommend extracting NewMasterModal, NewMarketEditionModal, ScheduleModal, FlowStrip into separate files under /pages/editorial/marketEditions/ for maintainability and easier unit testing.

MediaDeleteProtectionDrawer.jsx ENTITY_META maps both 'cms_page' and 'storefront_page' to the same href () => '/blueprint/experience' — neither uses the entity_id. If/when per-section deep-links are wired, replace with href: (id) => `/blueprint/experience?section=${id}`.

handleDuplicate in MarketEditionsToolbar uses Date.now().toString(36).slice(-4) for slug uniqueness — collision-resistant enough at human speed but not for batch duplication. Consider using crypto.randomUUID().slice(0,8) for safety.

Schedule guard is hard-coded server-side ('approved' or 'scheduled' only). The toolbar exposes 'Programma' as soon as a variant is selected regardless of status, leading to a 409 round-trip. Mirror the server guard on the client: disable schedule when selectedVariant.status not in {'approved','scheduled'}.

ReferencesPage ?openAdd=1 deep-link works on mount but the URL param is left in the address bar after the modal opens. Consider replacing history.replaceState to drop ?openAdd=1 once consumed to prevent re-trigger on browser refresh.
